title: Embedded-NUL public API audit
impact: Correctness guard for the remaining public text surfaces in `parameter-encoding-and-binding`: `selectBytes()` now has an assertion that SQLite `char(0)` TEXT decodes through native JSON bytes without truncation, and `stream()` now verifies both initial and changed emissions preserve embedded-NUL UTF-8 bytes. No runtime code or benchmark run; this consumes the signal-map's broader embedded-NUL audit candidate while leaving performance candidates unchanged.
